about.title: About Kohinoor Trends
about.body: Established in 1998 in the heart of Sector 17, Chandigarh, Kohinoor Trends is a premier boutique for women's ethnic and bridal wear. With a multi-generational appeal, our collections range from elegant cotton suits to exquisite lehengas and shawls. We take pride in our traditional craftsmanship and personalized service.
